extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern’s “Maternity Protect Series” (illustrated with “Maternity Protect Multiplier”) is a health/maternity protection plan for pregnancy, childbirth, and early childhood up to around the child’s toddler years (up to 3 years old). It provides a fixed “Pregnancy & Childbirth Complication Beneﬁt (Mother)” and “Hospital Care Beneﬁt” for both mother and child, with additional supports for eligible developmental delays and psychological consultations (including per-session limits). The brochure also highlights an “Early Delivery by Caesarean Section” benefit (up to S$3,750* as an additional payout) and “Mum Again” support described as a “Parental Retrenchment Cash Beneﬁt” payable once up to S$5,000 if either parent is retrenched unexpectedly. A key caveat is that the “GREAT Life Multiplier” is described as a separate policy, and other add-on/transfer options rely on timing rules such as exercising within 100 days from birth without medical underwriting (for eligible options).
quality_notes: The document includes multiple benefit types with some amounts stated in both summary copy and footnotes; some figures conflict across sections (e.g., table vs. narrative). Extraction uses only clearly stated amounts/limits from the provided text.
No explicit plan tier names (e.g., Plan A/B/C) are provided; only an illustrative basic sum assured (S$10,000) is shown.

The brochure mentions a separate “GREAT Life Multiplier (and any riders, if applicable)” but this document itself focuses on Maternity Protect benefits; the extracted policy is treated as the maternity product described here.

policies.quick_summary: A maternity-focused Great Eastern health plan covering pregnancy, childbirth, and early childhood support (mother and insured child). It includes complication and hospital cash benefits plus developmental support, psychological consultation benefits, and an early caesarean benefit, with an optional “Multiplier” concept described as bundled with whole-life protection. Some additional or future-protection options depend on exercising within 100 days from birth under the Guaranteed Insurability Beneﬁt (GIB). The brochure states the plan has no savings/investment feature and therefore no cash value.
policies.target_customer: Expecting parent(s) and the insured biological child(ren) covered under the policy, with coverage from pregnancy through early years up to 3 years old
coverage_scope: Early childhood coverage for congenital/juvenile conditions
Early delivery by caesarean section benefit
policies.eligibility_notes: Covers from pregnancy through the child’s early years up to 3 years old; some benefits have time limits such as ending at 120 days after birth or duration limits measured in days after birth.
policies.coverage_term_description: The brochure indicates coverage for pregnancy and childbirth and for the child’s early years, and specifies that certain benefit periods end at defined time/duration points after birth (e.g., hospital care up to 30 days in total or 120 days after birth, whichever earlier).
policy_termination_events: The brochure states that the plan has no savings/investment feature and thus has no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.
important_caveats: The brochure states the policy has no savings or investment feature and therefore has no cash value if policy ends or is terminated prematurely.

Some future-protection options depend on timing rules (e.g., exercising within 100 days after birth) and eligibility constraints under GIB or TOL (including stated exclusions such as hospitalisation plans for the GIB).
Certain benefits have duration limits after birth (e.g., hospital care ends when a time/duration threshold is reached).
